Title: Ethan Locke Clan Impersonated into a Kiasyd...

Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
Ethan Locke, as a Kiasyd, does his action thing to steal a master
discipline card off of someone else, and he says that he'll be using
the grandest trick for the duration of that combat.

So... What's up? Can he take the action? Can he gain the discipline
card (cause birthday cards say "Put this card on a vampire").

What happens if allies wind up with discipline cards? Vague question,
I know, but I want to see if anyone knows a way to do it (just for
shits and giggles).

~SV

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
vermillian wrote:
> Ethan Locke, as a Kiasyd, does his action thing to steal a master
> discipline card off of someone else, and he says that he'll be using

> the grandest trick for the duration of that [action].

>
> So... What's up? Can he take the action? Can he gain the discipline
> card (cause birthday cards say "Put this card on a vampire").

Good question.
It seems that it would work, except for an old RTR ruling to handle
the ruling that allowed formerly "Kindred Only" retainers to be
employed by allies. That addendum ruling will serve nicely here:

The following are "clearly" vampire-only: effects that burn
or gain blood, effects that grant or remove disciplines (or
clan or sect status, for that matter) effects that alter
capacity, and/or effects that grant or remove titles or votes.
[RTR 05-JAN-1999]

So the action to move a Discipline card to the acting minion is
an action that requires a vampire (and thus cannot be Grandest
Tricked).

> What happens if allies wind up with discipline cards? Vague question,
> I know, but I want to see if anyone knows a way to do it (just for

Nothing (card text).

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
vermillian wrote:
> Herald, Charming Lobby, Banishment on a vampire with a skill card?
> (that is, does this count as an effect that will alter one's capacity)

The Herald is free to Charming Lobby a Banishment "as a vampire".

It doesn't alter capacity, but even if it did, the Herald is Lobbying
"as a vampire", and capaciy-altering is not outside the purview of
"as a vampire".
